title: Investors transferring all their balances among their wallets or self-transferring on the same wallet causes to incorrectly decrement the investor counters causing DoS for other investors transfers
summary: This bug report discusses a problem in the `ComplianceServiceRegulated::recordTransfer()` function, which is responsible for adjusting investor counters when certain conditions are met. However, there are two edge cases that cause the counters to be incorrectly decremented. The first is when an existing investor transfers all their balance from one wallet to another, and the second is when an investor executes self-transfers from the same wallet. The root cause of the issue is that the function does not check if the sender and receiver investors are the same, and instead checks if the sender's investor is transferring all of their balance, regardless of whether the receiver is the same investor. This can lead to a denial of service for other investors and also allows for investor limits to be bypassed. The report provides proof of concept code to demonstrate the issue, and recommends a mitigation by skipping the check and decrement of investor counters when the investor of the sender and receiver wallets is the same. The report also mentions that this issue has been fixed in the code and has been verified by two different companies.
